chunk_text: Customs duties may vary according to the product type, declared value, country of origin, and destination country. Every imported commodity is classified under a specific Harmonized System (HS) code that dictates the applicable Basic Customs Duty (BCD), national goods and services taxes, and auxiliary cess charges.

Preferential tariff rates may be granted if the shipment is accompanied by a valid Certificate of Origin under a Bilateral or Multilateral Free Trade Agreement (FTA). Importers must ensure that the country of origin criteria and value addition thresholds are strictly satisfied.
